params.label: Message
params.description: The message. Wraps at the source's 220px column, so long text becomes a taller multi-line bubble. Wrap the whole message in *asterisks* for a roleplay action, which renders italic with the asterisks removed.

params.label: Sender
params.description: Which side the bubble is. "rep" is the companion - white bubble, dark text, left-aligned, growing from its bottom-left corner. "me" is the user - deep indigo bubble, white text, right-aligned, growing from its bottom-right. The short "r" / "m" work too, and the same vocabulary is what chat-thread-Rep's line prefixes use. Any other value is rejected rather than guessed at.

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: Clip length. The bubble arrives over a fixed 240ms and leaves over the same 240ms played backwards, whatever this is set to - the source is explicit that a slower arrival reads as broken - so this sets how long it holds in between. Below 0.48s there is no hold left and the arrival is what gets truncated; the exit is never clipped.
